disambiguation: It is a specialized AI research tool for generating structured knowledge trees, not a general-purpose chat interface.
extras: Uses DeepSeek as the default AI engine; API keys are stored securely in Obsidian SecretStorage.
intentEvidence: TreeTalk is a traceable, branching AI research tool for Obsidian.
problem: Researchers often struggle to maintain context, track sources, and synthesize complex, branching ideas within a standard note-taking environment.
summary: TreeTalk is an AI research tool that enables branching conversations and captures knowledge into structured Markdown notes and WikiLinks.
